required_fields.role_id: string exactly xstore-triage; declared role identity, not activation proof
required_fields.knowledge: object exactly {id: xstore-triage-procedures, version: 1.0.0, sha256: raw complete external pack-file SHA256, not deployment manifest SHA}
required_fields.observations: array of objects exactly {id: unique nonempty string, statement: nonempty string, source_refs: nonempty SourceRef array}
required_fields.gates: array of objects exactly {id: nonempty gate string, status: GateStatus, reason: nonempty string, observation_ids: array of existing observation ids}; supported/contradicted/stale require nonempty observation_ids; not_proven or not_applicable may have empty observation_ids only with an explicit reason for absent evidence or scoped nonapplicability
required_fields.next_checks: array of objects exactly {question: concrete read-only diagnostic/evidence question, reason: case-specific usefulness, source_refs: SourceRef array, execution: not_executed}; source_refs may be empty when asking for missing evidence
required_fields.blockers: array of nonempty strings describing essential missing inputs/access; nonempty when disposition=blocked
required_fields.limits: nonempty array of nonempty strings; independent semantic review remains required and no customer/live/native acceptance implied

SourceRef.path: safe relative path from the controller-provided selected input inventory; no absolute paths, traversal, symlink escape, URI or unsupplied file
SourceRef.end_line: integer >= start_line and <= actual file line count

disposition_rules: ready_for_review means useful assessment is ready for independent review; untested customer gates can remain not_proven. It never means task completed or independent acceptance.
blocked is required only when an essential missing input/tool/access prevents a requested conclusion; retain any supported partial observations. Do not convert every uncertainty into a blocked task.
out_of_scope is for non-Xstore requests; no invented Xstore observations or arbitrary diagnostic list.
Supported/contradicted/stale decisions require current relevant cited observations. A fluent unsupported conclusion or generic all-not-proven/all-blocked response fails positive case criteria.
Observations are facts in selected input ranges; hypotheses are explicitly labeled in summary/reason. No invented owner/date/cause/version facts. Redact sensitive values; use safe IDs and ranges.
A real existing-v1 TaskAssignment requires a genuine Handoff in addition to its owned assessment artifact. An unassigned advisory/source evaluation must not invent task/revision/selection identities.
